thread:
SRE-Bot: ALERT: Canary group 'prompt-routing/experimental-v1' crossed error threshold (5xx rate 11.9%, latency p95 2.3s) — routing ~6% of traffic. Auto-page to oncall. https://alerts.redwood.example/incidents/3124001111
Mia (oncall): I’m on it, paging PD. Assigning to myself. grabbing logs and the canary dashboard.
Jordan: I saw a spike on grafana too, reproducing 500s from the new endpoint. Stack traces point to a schema mismatch in the prompt adapter.
Mia (oncall): Good catch. Can we stop traffic to experimental route? Is feature-flag kill available?
Kevin: Yes we have a kill switch on the FF console. But if quick flip fails we can do routing fallback in the router. Which is faster?
Priya: Product here — we want minimal customer impact. Kill-FF first, then fallback if flip fails.
Mia (oncall): @Jordan can you attempt a targeted FF disable for canary slice 0-10%? Use the console and ops CLI as backup.
Jordan: Doing the console now. If that works I'll run the CLI to be atomic.
Deploy-Bot: deploys/feature-flag-service: request to toggle flag 'prompt.experimental_v1' from true -> false initiated by Jordan at 2026-03-15T14:22:30Z
Jordan: toggled via console for canary segment. Waiting for propagation.
SRE-Bot: feature-flag 'prompt.experimental_v1' set to OFF for segment canary-1 (10% traffic). Change ID: ff-4523.
Mia (oncall): Observability — error rate dropping?
Jordan: p95 down to 480ms, 5xx down to 2.8% and still trending lower.
Priya: Any customer-visible 5xx or latencies? Need list of affected tenants for comms.
Mia (oncall): Querying request logs for the window 14:15-14:30 — short list: tenant-7392, tenant-0213, tenant-cc-enterprise. They saw elevated 500s and timeouts.
Priya: Ok we’ll draft an in-product notice and send an outbound update for enterprise tenants.
Kevin: While this looks mitigated, we should cut traffic completely away from the experimental route. Jordan — can you set router policy to fallback to stable route immediately?
Jordan: Running router command now:
```
# routerctl
routerctl set-policy prompt-route --fallback stable --match endpoint=experimental-v1
routerctl status prompt-route
```
Jordan: Router accepted the new policy, traffic diverted. Confirming logs...
SRE-Bot: Router policy change accepted. Active route: stable.
Mia (oncall): Metrics check: p95 now 160ms, 5xx <0.2% global. Canary slice shows 0.0% after diversion.
Priya: Thanks team. For the incident record — duration ~14:18 to 14:26 for active failures. Impact: error spike affected ~2% of total requests during that window. A handful of enterprise customers experienced 500s.
Kevin: Good mitigation. We still need root cause — Jordan, onboarding code for prompt adapter had a marshaling change. Can we get a quick diff and revert plan? Also open a rollback PR for the adapter.
Jordan: Noted. I’ll open PR and rollback patch. Failure looks like a recent deserialization change that wasn't validated against older routing payloads.
Mia (oncall): Page to infra for a postmortem and timeline. I’m going to hand off to next oncall in 30 minutes. Please add any follow-ups to the incident tracker.
SRE-Bot: Incident #INC-20260315-14 created, severity: S2, owner: Mia. Follow-ups: postmortem required, customer notifications, FF audit, deploy guard for schema changes.
Priya: Draft for customer message (internal): "We briefly routed a small percentage of requests to an experimental prompt endpoint which returned errors between 14:18–14:26 UTC. We disabled the experiment and rerouted traffic; service performance has returned to normal. Affected customers may see short-term errors; we’ll follow up with root cause and remediation." Approve?
Kevin: Approve. Add contact for enterprise support.
Jordan: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/prompt-adapter/merge/1234 fix: revert serialization change. CI green, merging after one more approval.
Mia (oncall): I’m handing off to @Kevin for the next shift at 14:50 UTC. Kevin, you have the incident owner. I’ll attach logs and the FF change ID ff-4523 to the tracker.
Kevin: Taking over. Thanks Mia. Going to keep monitoring for 1 hour then close if stable.
SRE-Bot: Pager cleared. Next steps checklist: schedule postmortem, notify affected customers via account managers, add regression test for prompt payloads, add a pre-flight deploy check for FFs that change payload schemas.
Priya: I’ll coordinate customer comms and set up a short call with the integration owners for enterprise tenants.
Mia (oncall): Closing thread from responder side — handoff complete. :thumbsup:
